notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.6[/b]

Various Bugfixes...

Added ResetData Button in logo menu.

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
[b]Added Tons of new features and a few bugfixes![/b]

[b]New Content[/b]
- 4 New Secret Levels
- Second Player Added
- Added More Lore Content
- Added Occasional Effects
- Added Skip Level Option (Located In Menu When You Click Logo In Bottom Right)
- Added Statistics menu (Includes: Time, Deaths, And Skips)

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Made Game Load Slightly Faster
- Fixed Start Button Activating Multiple Times
- Fixed Pause Menu Opening Multiple Times

[b]Thanks For Playing The Game And Have Fun![/b]
